violated_contract: Sharing a telemetry client must not enable an emitter family whose own capture credential is absent or intentionally disabled. A global fallback to another family's valid credential silently expands deployed emission volume, including when the shared client was already constructed by an enabled family.
canonical_prevention: Resolve and validate family-owned credential admission before reusing the shared client. Never fall back across emitter families. Cover disabled project plus valid billing, cached-client reuse, absent and invalid family keys, and concurrent per-family credential routing through the pinned synchronous SDK.
